question: Find the median of the observations 6, 48, 32, 3, 37 and 18.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the data in ascending order: 3, 6, 18, 32, 37, 48

Total observations (n) = 6 (even number)

Median is the average of the two middle values.

Median = (18 + 32) ÷ 2 = 50 ÷ 2 = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 6, 48, 32, 3, 37 and 18.

**Formula Used:**

For an even number of observations (n), Median = [ (n/2)th term + (n/2 + 1)th term ] ÷ 2

 Observations in Ascending Order
 
 3
 
 6
 
 18
 
 32
 
 37
 
 48
 

 
• 
 

 Median = (18 + 32) ÷ 2 = 25

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, arrange the given data in ascending order: 3, 6, 18, 32, 37, 48

⇒ Total number of observations (n) = 6

⇒ Since n is an even number, the median is the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.

⇒ 3rd term = 18

⇒ 4th term = 32

⇒ Median = (18 + 32) ÷ 2

⇒ Median = 50 ÷ 2 = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

Mean is the average of the given set of values. It is calculated by dividing the sum of all observations by the total number of observations.

Mode

Mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. A set can have one mode, more than one mode, or no mode.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode is given by: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
